caption: The video captures three separate tongues of orange-yellow flame rising from the bottom edge against a uniform black background, placed at the left, center, and right. With bright yellow-white edges and darker orange interiors, the flames continuously flicker, curl, and deform as their tips stretch and bend. Through the earlier portion the left and center columns stand tall, the left repeatedly forming a hooked crown while the right stays low near the bottom-right edge. Later the left and center tongues shrink toward the bottom into short wavering stubs. Meanwhile the right flame grows into a taller defined column, its tip curling upward higher than before. The three columns remain distributed across the view, though the right tongue shifts inward from the far-right edge as it rises, and no separate object enters or leaves.
